guest: A little private note would be lovely, something about still happily getting lost together. Just no public fuss or rose-petal production, please.
reply: “Still happily getting lost together” is a lovely thought for a private note, without any public fuss or rose petals. Beyond revisiting the port, what do you and Marc most enjoy stumbling upon when you wander?

threads.detail: Returning to Nice for the tenth anniversary of meeting; will revisit the port, where they met over a hopelessly folded paper map. Nothing else planned yet.
